G-MET-PREVENT.description: What the metformin trials found about later Long COVID after treatment during acute infection.

sections.label: Answer
sections.title: What did the prevention trials find?
sections.paragraph: COVID-OUT reported a lower hazard of later clinician-diagnosed Long COVID, although an indexed correction and conflicting cumulative-incidence values complicate interpretation. ACTIV-6 did not meet its efficacy threshold for its primary long-term symptom outcome.

sentences.text: COVID-OUT reported a lower hazard of later clinician-diagnosed Long COVID, although an indexed correction and conflicting cumulative-incidence values complicate interpretation. ACTIV-6 did not meet its efficacy threshold for its primary long-term symptom outcome.

sections.label: Context
sections.title: When treatment began
sections.paragraph: Both studies began treatment during acute COVID-19. They address prevention of later illness; the separate Korean trial tested treatment after Long COVID symptoms were already established.

sentences.text: Both studies began treatment during acute COVID-19. They address prevention of later illness; the separate Korean trial tested treatment after Long COVID symptoms were already established.

sections.label: Evidence
sections.title: Symptoms and diagnosis were different outcomes
sections.paragraph: In ACTIV-6, the adjusted risk difference for symptoms attributed to COVID-19 or death at six months was −0.8 percentage points, with a 95% credible interval of −2.2 to 0.6. The secondary clinician-diagnosis estimate was −0.7 percentage points, with an interval of −1.5 to 0.1. Both intervals included no difference.

sentences.text: In ACTIV-6, the adjusted risk difference for symptoms attributed to COVID-19 or death at six months was −0.8 percentage points, with a 95% credible interval of −2.2 to 0.6. The secondary clinician-diagnosis estimate was −0.7 percentage points, with an interval of −1.5 to 0.1. Both intervals included no difference.

sections.label: Limits
sections.title: Why the findings differ
sections.paragraph: COVID-OUT enrolled adults with overweight or obesity and no known prior infection. ACTIV-6 included a different vaccination and prior-infection context, had relatively few long-term events and 593 missing symptom outcomes. These differences limit direct comparison.

sentences.text: COVID-OUT enrolled adults with overweight or obesity and no known prior infection. ACTIV-6 included a different vaccination and prior-infection context, had relatively few long-term events and 593 missing symptom outcomes. These differences limit direct comparison.

faqs.question: Does a diagnosis endpoint measure every persistent symptom?
faqs.answer: No. A clinician diagnosis and a symptom-based endpoint count different outcomes, as illustrated by ACTIV-6’s primary and secondary analyses.

sentences.text: No. A clinician diagnosis and a symptom-based endpoint count different outcomes, as illustrated by ACTIV-6’s primary and secondary analyses.

G-MET-TREAT.description: The randomized metformin result for recovery after Long COVID was already established.

sections.label: Answer
sections.title: Did metformin improve recovery?
sections.paragraph: The South Korean randomized trial found no significant improvement in eight-week recovery after a two-week metformin course. Recovery occurred in 84 of 132 metformin participants and 90 of 132 placebo participants.

sentences.text: The South Korean randomized trial found no significant improvement in eight-week recovery after a two-week metformin course. Recovery occurred in 84 of 132 metformin participants and 90 of 132 placebo participants.

sections.label: Context
sections.title: What recovery meant
sections.paragraph: The trial defined recovery using its PASC symptom-index threshold. That endpoint measures the trial’s specified recovery criterion; it does not imply that every symptom had disappeared.

sentences.text: The trial defined recovery using its PASC symptom-index threshold. That endpoint measures the trial’s specified recovery criterion; it does not imply that every symptom had disappeared.

sections.label: Evidence
sections.title: What the comparison establishes
sections.paragraph: Both groups improved, but metformin did not show an advantage over placebo. The result concerns the tested two-week course and population, including the trial’s limitation in applying the findings to more severe or persistent illness.

sentences.text: Both groups improved, but metformin did not show an advantage over placebo. The result concerns the tested two-week course and population, including the trial’s limitation in applying the findings to more severe or persistent illness.

sections.label: Limits
sections.title: The separate fatigue report was retracted
sections.paragraph: The original REVIVE fluvoxamine and metformin report has a notice of retraction and republication. Its original fatigue findings are excluded from benefit conclusions.

sentences.text: The original REVIVE fluvoxamine and metformin report has a notice of retraction and republication. Its original fatigue findings are excluded from benefit conclusions.

faqs.question: Does this trial settle every treatment duration?
faqs.answer: No. It tested a two-week course with recovery measured at eight weeks. Longer courses and different illness populations are different research questions.

sentences.text: No. It tested a two-week course with recovery measured at eight weeks. Longer courses and different illness populations are different research questions.

G-NMV-TREAT.description: What randomized trials of extended nirmatrelvir–ritonavir found in established Long COVID.

sections.label: Answer
sections.title: What did the trials find?
sections.paragraph: STOP-PASC did not demonstrate a significant improvement in its primary symptom-severity outcome. RECOVER-VITAL also reported no significant primary benefit in its studied symptom groups.

sentences.text: STOP-PASC did not demonstrate a significant improvement in its primary symptom-severity outcome. RECOVER-VITAL also reported no significant primary benefit in its studied symptom groups.

sections.label: Context
sections.title: A treatment question after acute infection
sections.paragraph: Participants already had persistent symptoms. The control included ritonavir with placebo, allowing the comparison to isolate the addition of nirmatrelvir; it was not a comparison with no medication.

sentences.text: Participants already had persistent symptoms. The control included ritonavir with placebo, allowing the comparison to isolate the addition of nirmatrelvir; it was not a comparison with no medication.

sections.label: Evidence
sections.title: The fatigue estimate was uncertain
sections.paragraph: In STOP-PASC, the adjusted between-group fatigue-score change differed by 0.38 points, with a 95% confidence interval from −2.40 to 3.15. The interval included differences in both directions.

sentences.text: In STOP-PASC, the adjusted between-group fatigue-score change differed by 0.38 points, with a 95% confidence interval from −2.40 to 3.15. The interval included differences in both directions.

sections.label: Limits
sections.title: Population and follow-up
sections.paragraph: STOP-PASC was a small, single-center study and ended early after reaching its futility criterion. RECOVER-VITAL studied several symptom groups with different primary outcomes, which need separate interpretation.

sentences.text: STOP-PASC was a small, single-center study and ended early after reaching its futility criterion. RECOVER-VITAL studied several symptom groups with different primary outcomes, which need separate interpretation.

faqs.question: Is this the same as treating acute COVID-19?
faqs.answer: No. These studies enrolled people with persistent symptoms; acute treatment starts near the beginning of infection and has different outcomes.

sentences.text: No. These studies enrolled people with persistent symptoms; acute treatment starts near the beginning of infection and has different outcomes.
